instruction:
Directly modify the stackup in the real Altium native board file `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\wifi_board.PcbDoc` instead of exporting IPC XML. Save the modified native document as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\wifi_stackup.PcbDoc`.

Requirements:
- Change `LAYER2NAME` to `GND_INNER`.
- Change `LAYER3NAME` to `PWR_INNER`.
- Change both `LAYER2DIELCONST` and `LAYER3DIELCONST` to `4.200`.
- Change both `LAYER1COPTHICK` and `LAYER32COPTHICK` to `1.0mil`.

Do not reduce the task to generating an external configuration file; the evaluation checks stackup parameters inside the native `.PcbDoc`.
source: Local Altium example `Mini PC - WiFi\WiFi.PcbDoc`; benchmark task restored from text-only IPC configuration generation to native stackup editing.
